claims.text: titles: Lão Tử (tên sách, sau gọi Đạo đức kinh)

sources.quote: has come to be called simply the Laozi, after its putative author
it acquired a more exalted and hermeneutically instructive title, Daodejing

claims.text: tác giả: Lão Tử (gán theo truyền thống)

sources.quote: Laozi the ancient philosopher is said to have written a short book
Laozi is the name of a legendary Daoist philosopher, the alternate title of the early Chinese text better known in the West as the Daodejing

notes: year null, years_seen rỗng: chỉ kiểm tên và tác giả. Tác giả là gán theo truyền thống; SEP: 'There is little consensus among scholars, however, on the date or authorship of the Laozi'. Hồ sơ trang đã ghi rõ điều này.
